 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Continue an already-formed diagonal run of a non-background color.
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                er, ec = nr + dr, nc + dc
                if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color
                    and 0 <= er < h and 0 <= ec < w and grid[er][ec] == background):
                    candidates.append((counts[color], r, c, dr, dc, color, er, ec))
    if candidates:
        # Prefer the least frequent patterned foreground color; extend its diagonal.
        _, _, _, _, _, color, er, ec = min(candidates)
        out[er][ec] = color
    return out
"
